answer: Nonce-Ladder Task Chain. Each identity must solve a fresh, agent-specific task whose answer depends on a secret pulse issued per round; the answer is a one-time thread binding identity to that round's zephyr seed, so replay fails. Enforcement: submissions are checked against the live seed and discarded once used. Cost: an attacker must acquire and solve a new task per identity per round, making mass fabrication linear in compute and seed access.
